summary.text: Nevin Dexter is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Nevin Dexter also ran for Strafford 9 in 2022, advancing from the September 13, 2022 Democratic primary unopposed.
In the November 8, 2022 general election, Brandon Phinney defeated Dexter, 887 votes to 872.
